digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow completion recovery, gate error reporting
propositions: Step-budget repetition diagnostic is computed in interpret_failure but dropped before reaching the operator message because raise_completion_workflow_failure and gate_error_v1 sidecar emission are unreachable when budget exhaustion occurs

The _bounded_diagnostic allowlist filter strips tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, and distinct_ratio_window keys that would distinguish looping from budget exhaustion
Operator-facing close-gate failure messages lack repetition counters (distinct vs total tool calls), forcing ambiguity between loop constraint violations and actual budget exhaustion
The list-valued top_repeated_tool_calls field fails to survive diagnostic merges due to a scalar-only guard that should permit this specific key
